tools.name: peopleforce_list_employees
tools.description: List employees with status, job position, department, division, location, manager and hire date. Filter by status, ids, emails or employee numbers. Company API: GET /employees.

tools.name: peopleforce_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id with contact, job, department, division, location and manager fields. Company API: GET /employees/{id}.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_terminated_employees
tools.description: List employees who left, with termination date and comment. Company API: GET /employees/terminated.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_employee_leave_balances
tools.description: List one employee's leave balances per leave type, with the effective date. Company API: GET /employees/{id}/leave_balances.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_employee_tasks
tools.description: List onboarding or HR tasks assigned to one employee. Company API: GET /employees/{id}/tasks.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_departments
tools.description: List departments with parent, manager and level. Company API: GET /departments.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_divisions
tools.description: List divisions. Company API: GET /divisions.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_locations
tools.description: List office and work locations with time zone and country. Company API: GET /locations.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_teams
tools.description: List teams with the team lead and team members. Company API: GET /teams.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_positions
tools.description: List job positions (titles). Company API: GET /positions.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_job_profiles
tools.description: List job profiles with job group and salary band limits. Company API: GET /job_profiles.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_leave_requests
tools.description: List leave requests with state, dates, amount, leave type and approvals. Filter by employee, state or date range. Company API: GET /leave_requests.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_pending_leave_requests
tools.description: List leave requests waiting for approval. Company API: GET /leave_requests/pending.

tools.name: peopleforce_get_leave_request
tools.description: Get one leave request by id with its entries and approvals. Company API: GET /leave_requests/{id}.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_leave_types
tools.description: List leave types (for example vacation or sick leave) with unit and colour. Company API: GET /leave_types.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_holidays
tools.description: List public holidays with their date and holiday policy. Company API: GET /holidays.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_timesheets
tools.description: List monthly timesheet totals per employee: expected, worked, break and leave minutes. Company API: GET /time/timesheets.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_timesheet_entries
tools.description: List clock-in and clock-out entries in a date range, with minutes and type. Filter by approval status. Company API: GET /time/timesheet_entries.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_recruitment_vacancies
tools.description: List open and closed job vacancies with title, pipeline, location and dates. Company API: GET /recruitment/vacancies.

tools.name: peopleforce_get_recruitment_vacancy
tools.description: Get one vacancy by id with its pipeline, hiring lead and description. Company API: GET /recruitment/vacancies/{id}.

tools.name: peopleforce_list_recruitment_candidates
tools.description: List job candidates with contact fields, skills and their applications. Filter by email, vacancy or pipeline stage. Company API: GET /recruitment/candidates.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: peopleforce_list_employees, peopleforce_list_terminated_employees, peopleforce_list_recruitment_candidates · Private data: peopleforce_get_employee, peopleforce_list_recruitment_candidates · Public sink: peopleforce_list_recruitment_candidates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: peopleforce_list_employees, peopleforce_list_terminated_employees, peopleforce_list_recruitment_candidates · Private data: peopleforce_get_employee, peopleforce_list_recruitment_candidates · Public sink: peopleforce_list_recruitment_candidates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
